### Location of the Text
Where is this text located? (e.g., Language file, UI Button, Tooltip, Error message).

### Current Text
What does the text say right now?

### Corrected Text
What *should* the text say?

### Screenshot
If possible, attach a screenshot showing the typo or layout breaking due to text length.
